en.headline: Fisherman dies after suspected lightning strike on sampan off Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old man was found unconscious on a sampan near the Cross Bay Link during the red rainstorm warning and was certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.
body: Police received a report at about 9.14 a.m. on Thursday that a man had collapsed on a sampan in the waters near the Tseung Kwan O Cross Bay Link while a red rainstorm warning and thunderstorm warning were in force.

Marine police and rescue personnel located the vessel and transferred the 67-year-old fisherman, surnamed Sin, to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he was certified dead. Officers noted burns on his neck, chest, left back and right arm; preliminary investigation indicated he was struck by lightning while at sea.

The man, who lived in Shau Kei Wan and regularly went out fishing in the early morning, had a history of hypertension. An autopsy will determine the exact cause of death. The case has been classified as a dead-on-arrival incident and is being followed up by the Tseung Kwan O police district.

zh.headline: 將軍澳六旬漁民疑遭雷擊 舢舨上昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 紅雨期間一名67歲男子在跨灣大橋對開海面舢舨上暈倒，送將軍澳醫院後證實死亡，初步懷疑遭雷電擊中。
body: 警方今早約9時14分接獲途經船隻乘客報案，指將軍澳跨灣大橋附近海面一艘舢舨上有人暈倒，當時紅色暴雨警告及雷暴警告仍然生效。
水警及救援人員到場將67歲姓冼漁民送往將軍澳醫院，其後證實不治。遺體檢查發現頸部、心口、左背及右手臂有多處燒傷，初步相信事主出海作業期間遭雷電擊中。
事主居於筲箕灣，習慣清晨出海捕魚，本身患有高血壓。死因有待驗屍確定，案件列作抵達時死亡，交由將軍澳警區跟進。
